rules.accepted_credit_types: Pre-approved sponsors listed by the Board (incl. AVMA-recognized specialty groups, NAVTA); AAVSB RACE-approved programs accepted automatically; Board-approved sponsors; individual approval on request
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE waived for the first renewal period of all Minnesota licenses.
rules.alternatives: Six-month extension for good cause; inactive license needs no CE.
rules.audit_note: Summer CE audits; keep documentation at least 4 years.
rules.notes: CE period March 1 - February 28 of the 2-year license. At least 30 h interactive (lectures, labs, live online); max 10 h non-interactive (journal reading = 1 credit per 3 h); max 10 h practice management. 1 h = 50 min.
